question: What can SCSS functions do vs mixins?
shortAnswer: Functions return values (colors, numbers, lists) used in properties; they should not emit CSS side effects.
detailedAnswer: Keep functions pure. Built-ins live under sass:math, sass:color, sass:map, etc. modules.

question: Why math.div instead of / for division?
shortAnswer: Slash became ambiguous (also separator); sass:math.div is explicit and future-proof.
detailedAnswer: Migrate legacy / division. Enable warnings during upgrades.

question: How do map.get / map.merge support token systems?
shortAnswer: Read and compose token maps without hard-coding keys everywhere; merge themes.
detailedAnswer: Fail loudly on missing keys via custom getters that @error. Prevents silent nulls.

question: Color functions in modern Sass — guidance?
shortAnswer: Prefer sass:color APIs; many legacy darken/lighten are deprecated in favor of clearer color-space aware functions.
detailedAnswer: Design systems often compute on OKLCH/CSS color and limit Sass color math. Know deprecations for interviews.

question: Write a function that returns a spacing token by name.
shortAnswer: Accept key, look up in $spacers map, @error if missing, return value.
detailedAnswer: Centralizes failures at compile time — better than emitting invalid CSS.

question: When to @error vs @warn in functions?
shortAnswer: @error fails the build for invalid API use; @warn for deprecations/migrations.
detailedAnswer: Libraries should @error on bad keys. Don't warn-spam on every include.

question: List/map iteration functions — practical use?
shortAnswer: Generate utility classes, CSS variables, or variant selectors from data structures.
detailedAnswer: Data-driven CSS beats copy-paste. Keep generators readable and documented.

question: Debugging: function returns unexpected null.
shortAnswer: Missing map key, wrong namespace, or using deprecated color ops that behave differently.
detailedAnswer: Add guards. Unit-test Sass with True/sass-true if critical.

question: Can functions replace design-token packages?
shortAnswer: They can encapsulate access, but source tokens should still be data (maps/JSON) owned centrally.
detailedAnswer: Functions are API; maps are data. Don't bury tokens only inside opaque functions without export.

question: Interpolation inside functions — care?
shortAnswer: Functions primarily return values; building selectors usually belongs in mixins/loops.
detailedAnswer: Keep responsibilities clear to avoid unreadable meta-CSS.

question: Compare SCSS functions to CSS calc/min/max/clamp.
shortAnswer: SCSS resolves at build time with known tokens; CSS computes at runtime with relative units/layout.
detailedAnswer: Use clamp for fluid type in CSS; use Sass for token algebra known at build.

question: Scenario: theme function must support dark/light.
shortAnswer: Pass theme map or use CSS variables for runtime; Sass function can select compile-time theme builds.
detailedAnswer: Multiple theme CSS files vs one file with CSS vars — choose per product needs.

question: Lead: standardize Sass function libraries across brands.
shortAnswer: Shared sass toolkit package, documented function contracts, deprecation policy, and CI compiling sample consumers.
detailedAnswer: Breakages ripple widely — semantic versioning required.

question: What is meta.type-of / inspection used for?
shortAnswer: Guard arguments in public functions (ensure map/number) before computing.
detailedAnswer: Defensive library APIs. Pair with clear @error messages.
